title: OCD Android's weekly report to the relay (ocd-week-report v1)
description: What a ROM install of OCD Android sends once a week per SIM after the person's yes (OCD rule round 48, item 2). It holds no identifier, no free text, no day or time and no call details. Anything else is refused whole. Two rules no schema here can say: week is the current or the previous ISO week at the relay's clock, and each entry appears once. The body is at most 4096 bytes.

model.description: Build.MODEL when it is on OCD's public generated/devices/android.json, else the word other.

carrier.description: The matched OCD profile's ID, or the home network code (MCC and MNC, no separator) only when no profile matches.

entry.description: A feature switch, or apn: and the row key of a row OCD's own data has for this SIM's network. A row with the emergency type is refused.

result.description: works: calls both ways on this SIM, bearer and build, by packet counts. calls_out: an outgoing call only. Neither checks sound or speaks for emergency calls. With any ims_stack but aosp_imsstack (SM8) only signed_in, service_off and not_possible are allowed.
